program_narrative: UTLMON00 is a batch system-monitoring utility. It opens the monitor configuration file MONITOR-CONFIG and the DB2 statistics file DB2-STATS for input and the files MONITOR-LOG and ALERT-FILE for output; any failed open is displayed on the console and ends the run with RETURN-CODE 12. It reads the system time into WS-TIMESTAMP and loads every configuration record (resource type, threshold type and value, alert level and action) through 1310-STORE-CONFIG. It then repeats a monitoring cycle until the hour field reads 23: collect CPU, memory, DASD and DB2 metrics, check utilisation, response, queue and error thresholds, log the timestamp and resource/performance values to MONITOR-LOG, format and write an alert when a threshold is met, call the runtime routine ILBOABN0 with the current minute, and refresh the time. Finally it closes all four files. Almost all detail logic (13 performed paragraphs) and the DB2-STATS record layout (COPY DB2STAT) are missing from the source, so metric collection, threshold rules, log content and alert content cannot be described. Error conditions handled: file open failures (fatal).
